name: hyte-monorepo-example
description: Web-client (vite) and server (express) example dev in the same repository.
author: mattpe

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "cd server && npm run dev" "cd hyte-web-client && npm run dev"
scripts.build-client: cd hyte-web-client && npm install && npm run build && rm -rf ../server/public/* && mv dist/* ../server/public/ && cd ..
scripts.deploy: pm2 delete hyte-server; npm run build-client && cd server && npm install --production && pm2 start src/index.js --name hyte-server && cd ..
